identity description: A small woven wicker market basket with a single arched handle. Honey amber woven strips in a simple crisscross pattern, a folded sage green cloth peeking out over the rim on one side.
A chubby round glass honey jar full of golden amber honey, a cream cloth cover tied over the lid with brass string, and a wooden honey dipper leaning out from under the cloth.
A long crusty French baguette loaf with three diagonal scored cuts on top, golden amber crust with lighter cream inside the cuts, wrapped halfway in a sage green paper sleeve.
A round paper festival lantern with vertical ribs, warm red-orange paper with honey amber end caps on top and bottom, a short brass hanging loop on top and a small sage green tassel hanging below.
A round wheel of cheese with one wedge cut out, showing pale cream-yellow inside with three round holes, honey amber rind, a small sage green paper label band around the side with no writing.
A small round leather coin purse with a brass kiss-lock clasp on top, honey amber leather with a sage green stitched band, slightly open with two brass coins peeking out.

An old balance scale for a market stall. A brass central pillar on a round sage green base, a straight crossbar on top, and two shallow brass pans hanging on short chains, one pan holding a small red apple.
A brass countertop service bell (shop bell) with a dome and a small push button on top, sitting on a round sage green wooden base, a tiny honey amber ribbon bow tied to the base.
